# KRN capability index (generated by scripts/claude/capability-index.ts; fast rewrites it)
Before calling anything foreign, unknown or missing, grep this index and src.

## krn commands
krn task <ready|claim|show|list|create|edit|comment|dep|close|release|check> [...]: repository work tracker; `krn task` 
krn ledger [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--pr N] [--limit N] [--repo OWNER/REPO] [--root DIR] [--transcripts DIR] [--json]: outc
krn standards check|propose|harvest [...]: check [--root DIR]: run the enforcement of every standard that applies to a r
krn doctor: reports the host `krn task` entry, its commit and origin/main; exit 78 when stale or unpinned; `krn doctor -
krn state check|resume|set|accept|handoff|retro [--root DIR]: delivery-loop capsule check, resume brief and writers; che
krn lane start|run|drop|brief [...]: run: start the lane, run one headless claude session on a task, ship the commit (ex
krn decide add|list|close [...]: operator decisions: rows with a recommendation, a default and a deadline under .krn/ope
krn findings validate <file>: check review findings JSON: confirmed needs path:line evidence, a reproduce command and a 
krn repo contract [--root DIR]: print the repo contract as JSON: base branch, test, related ({files}) and fast commands,
krn plan [--root DIR]: one line: plan points left per account (5h, 7d) from .krn/plan/samples.jsonl and the account to s
krn adopt <path> [--tracker] [--ref SHA [--install|--lint|--typecheck CMD]] [--test CMD] [--init [--stack S]]: write krn
krn hook stop|scope [--check|--related]: Claude Code hook entry: stdin payload in; stop exits 2 to refuse a worker Stop 
krn ci wait|logs: wait: --repo OWNER/REPO --pr N --head SHA --base SHA [--timeout-seconds N] [--start-timeout-seconds N]
krn pr ship --title TITLE --body-file PATH [--repo OWNER/REPO] [--force]: in a branch worktree: push, create the PR, ena
